findings.namedBuyers: Yannick Grivel, President; Alessandra Gaffuri, Vice-president; and Marie-Sophie Ludewig, Logistics lead, are verified on the organizer committee page. Grivel and Gaffuri are appropriate senior entry points for commercial partnership routing; Ludewig is relevant to operational lodging/transport feasibility. These relevance judgments are inferences, not proof that any individual controls hotel contracts. Statutes assign third-party representation to the steering committee. Public shared route: info@trinyon.ch.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced 38th edition: 7–8 August 2027, Nyon. Swiss Triathlon explicitly states: “La 38ème édition se déroulera les 7 et 8 août 2027”. The federation’s provisional 2027 calendar independently lists 07./08.08.2027. These are activity dates, not publication dates, and fall within the requested horizon. The organizer homepage still advertises the past 7–9 August 2026 edition. No 2028 edition announcement was located; do not roll the August pattern forward.
findings.hotelProductFit: Commercial inference using the supplied YOTEL specifications: a Founex airport-corridor hotel can plausibly serve visiting clubs, officials, support teams and athlete families attending Nyon, with bedrooms and optional small briefings/F&B rather than hosting the competition. A 20–120-room band is a hotel sales targeting constraint, NOT an event demand estimate; no evidence supports a whole-house block or any specific minimum. Neither a resort setting nor downtown Geneva location is required by the published general-event programme. Early starts, bikes, early breakfast and transfer reliability must be validated before proposing a package. Historical FISU placement at Everness in Chavannes-de-Bogis demonstrates nearby corridor lodging use for that separate 2026 delegation cohort, not a YOTEL booking or a 2027 requirement.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 exact venue: unconfirmed. The official 2027 announcement does not name a facility or address. Historical 2026 venue is Centre sportif de Colovray, route de Genève 37, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland, explicitly documented in the organizer access page and dated 2026 athlete guide. Territory: Nyon / La Côte, not Geneva city or Lausanne. It is a sports venue, not an incumbent hotel. Historical use is not evidence of a signed 2027 venue commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Evidence indicates a locally anchored Nyon series, not a rotating destination congress: 35th edition 10–11 August 2024 at Centre sportif de Colovray; 36th edition 9–10 August 2025 across Nyon, Crans, Arnex-sur-Nyon and Eysins, with Colovray pool parking reserved for the event; 37th edition advertised 7–9 August 2026 at Colovray, including the university championship programme. Statutes explicitly mandate organizing the Triathlon de Nyon each summer. Do not infer that the separate FISU championship recurs in Nyon in 2027.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing is unconfirmed: no edition-specific housing bureau, room allotment, open RFP, booking deadline or exclusive hotel commitment was found. Historical/current organizer pages name one general-event accommodation partner: The Bowling Hotel, Signy. Exact wording: “Notre partenaire, The Bowling Hotel, se réjouit de vous accueillir…” and “N’hésitez pas à prévoir en avance votre logement au Bowling Hotel et profitez de tarifs avantageux !” This supports a promoted hotel/direct-booking referral, not a verified room block. Separately, the co-located FISU 2026 championship published a stronger delegation commitment: “All delegations will be accommodated at the Hôtel Everness in Nyon”. Everness’s own address is Ch des Champs-Blancs 70B, 1279 Chavannes-de-Bogis; the FISU description uses Nyon loosely. The Bowling Hotel and Hôtel Everness are all the event-associated hotels identified in these two distinct pathways. Neither historical arrangement establishes 2027 inventory availability.
findings.organizationStructure: Event owner/operator is the nonprofit association “Triathlon de Nyon”, seated in Nyon, constituted under Swiss Civil Code articles 60 et seq.; autonomous since its 2014 separation from Cercle des Nageurs de Nyon. Its statutes were revised 10 March 2026. It is a Swiss Triathlon member, not the same entity as the federation/calendar publisher. Organizer describes the event as 100% volunteer-run. No PCO/DMC or external hotel contracting agent was identified. Habefast is credited for website/communications work, not evidenced as a hotel buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The Bowling Hotel has a published general-event partnership; Everness had the explicitly assigned FISU 2026 delegation cohort. No published sell-out, overflow requirement, competitor displacement opportunity, unallocated room count, room-night total or 2027 exclusivity was found. General participation is not hotel demand: Swiss Triathlon reports 2,884 participants for the 35th edition (2024), while the 2026 organizer homepage markets 2,500+ athletes, 8,000+ spectators and 300 volunteers without establishing a final audited 2026 turnout. These must not be converted to room nights.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info@trinyon.ch for Yannick Grivel and Alessandra Gaffuri, copying/routing to Marie-Sophie Ludewig for logistics. Ask who manages 2027 participant versus organizer/team lodging, whether Bowling Hotel partner rights continue, whether any paid organizer/official rooms or club blocks are required, and whether a second hotel/referral is permissible. If welcomed, offer a modest, demand-led block within the supplied 20–120-room commercial band, with rate/release terms, early breakfast, bike handling and transport options subject to hotel confirmation. Confirm Colovray and 2027 road access before pricing transfers. Do not hold speculative 120-room inventory or pitch displacement of FISU 2026 commitments.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 16 November 2026, the 2026 edition is past and not saleable. The next announced edition is 7–8 August 2027. Dates are accessible for relationship development, but hotel procurement access remains unverified; do not label sourcing open or infer a right to displace existing partners. The 2026 guide documents 06:00 registration, 08:00 starts and parking closures; the 2026 access page warns of congestion. These are historical planning constraints, not confirmed 2027 arrangements.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue a complementary 2027 club/official/support-team lodging relationship or an agreed booking referral, subject to partner rights and travel feasibility. The annual summer purpose in the statutes supports recurring relationship value, but does not prove an annual transferable hotel tender. Do not target FISU delegation housing as recurring 2027 demand; that was a distinct 2026 commitment. No 2028 date or hotel procurement cycle was verified.
